Sam (People Ops): Quick policy pilot: starting 2027-06-01 we’re launching the Caregiver Flex & Backup Subsidy pilot. Two parts: (1) up to 2 flexible telework days/week for primary caregivers (no change to core hours) and (2) a $500/year Backup Care Subsidy to cover emergency childcare/eldercare. Details below.

Rina (Benefits): Pilot aims to help employees juggling unpredictable caregiving without forcing PTO use. Subsidy reimburses eligible invoices (in-home sitter, backup daycare, eldercare center). Receipts required.

Oliver (Legal): Eligibility: employees with at least 3 months of service who self-identify as primary caregiver. This is a benefit, not a protected leave; ADA and statutory family leave rights still apply separately.

Priya (Payroll): Subsidy is taxable in most jurisdictions and will be paid through payroll as `BACKUP-2027` code. We’ll provide country notes. Reimbursements under $50 treated as expense; over $50 routed through payroll for tax handling.

Jordan (Eng Manager): For the flexible telework days, do managers need to approve recurring schedules or just ad-hoc? We have sprint planning constraints.

Sam (People Ops): Recommend recurring patterns for predictability (e.g., Tuesdays + Thursdays remote) approved by manager for the quarter. Ad-hoc flexibility allowed for emergencies but should be communicated to the manager ASAP. Core overlap hours must be respected for meetings.

Sam (People Ops): Quick FAQ: https://intranet.redwood/workplace/policies/caregiver-flex-backup-2027. Reimbursement form & approved vendor list: https://intranet.redwood/people/backup-care.

Rina (Benefits): Pilot is 6 months (2027-06-01 to 2027-11-30). We’ll review utilization and employee feedback. Subsidy limit $500/year pro-rated for new hires. Telework flexibility remains subject to role requirements (some production-critical roles may need different arrangements).

Oliver (Legal): Managers should not request proof beyond a basic attestation to respect privacy. If pattern suggests abuse, People Ops will review confidentially.

Jordan (Eng Manager): What about contractors? We often have contractors who are primary caregivers.

Sam (People Ops): Contractors not eligible for subsidy but managers can consider schedule accommodations case-by-case. We’ll publish guidance for managers working with contractors.

Priya (Payroll): Action: Payroll to add `BACKUP-2027` code by 2027-05-15. Benefits to draft sample manager email & scheduling template by 2027-05-25.

Sam (People Ops): Manager brief + AMA: 2027-05-28 16:00 UTC. Please add edge cases to the policy doc comments. :heart:

Jordan (Eng Manager): Appreciate this. Small ask: can we add a short one-pager for hiring docs so recruiters can highlight this?

Rina (Benefits): Will do — recruiter blurb ready by 2027-05-20.

Sam (People Ops): Thanks all. If you need an early exception (e.g., critical caregiver need before pilot start) DM People Ops and we’ll handle interim support. :seedling:
